data.explanation: Your employer is offering an addendum (Zusatzvereinbarung) to your employment contract for mobile working, up to two days per week, starting 1 June 2026. To accept, sign it and send it back to the HR department (Personalabteilung) within 10 working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) of the letter date. The app shows the exact date. Read the terms before signing. If anything is unclear, ask HR or seek advice, for example from a works council or union.
